records.identity: EPA Record of Decision for Northernaire Plating Company and Kysor of Cadillac groundwater remedy, signed September 29, 1989, with administrative-record indexes and responsiveness summary.
supportedFindings: Pages 1-4 and 39-47 select groundwater extraction/treatment, Kysor soil-vapor extraction, monitoring and use restrictions; the stated cost and cleanup durations are estimates, not completed work.
Pages 8-9, 58 and 60 distinguish Northernaire-attributed hexavalent chromium from VOCs reported as originating from other sources and mixed within the same aquifer.
Pages 100-112 document public/PRP/State comments, a commingled plume with multiple origins, exclusion of the separable Rexair plume, and Michigan's disagreement with EPA's 5-ppb TCE target.
Pages 73-99 are administrative-record and sampling/data indexes; pages 113-114 list community-relations activities. Indexed records are leads, not attachments contained in this PDF.
records.limits: Historical VOC/chromium remedy record. It contains no PFAS testing and does not prove a current Wexford Landfill-to-Cadillac WWTP-to-Plett Road pathway.

coverage.ocr: Native text was complete; the overwritten line on page 5 was verified from the rendered page.

records.identity: Signed July 29, 1995 EPA Region 5 statutory first five-year review for Northernaire Plating Company.
supportedFindings: Pages 3-4 report October 4-November 17, 1988 source-control work, approximately 1,016 cubic yards excavated, and a May 8, 1991 final inspection.

Pages 4-5 state that the groundwater system remained under construction, report chromium not detected in the closest cited spring 1995 near-surface downgradient well, explicitly say cadmium was not sampled, and recommend additional chromium/cadmium sampling.
Page 5 certifies the selected remedies as protective as of the review date while requiring continued groundwater-remedy implementation and future review.
records.limits: The 1995 protectiveness statement is not proof of present conditions. The record contains no PFAS testing or current Plett Road source attribution.
